lastCheckedNote: Daily-editor sweep 2026-08-24: advanced the fallback to the Sunday 23 August close at 676.70, read as the previous-close field on Investing.com's Al-Quds (PLE) quote page while Monday's session was trading at 675.62 on the page's delayed quote. PEX trades Sunday to Thursday, so 23 August is the last completed session and 676.70 is a settled close — this file never carries an intraday level. The sequence corroborates it: yesterday's sweep read the same page's previous close as 673.50, the 20 August level this file then held. pex.ps still returns HTTP 403 to server-side clients and raya.ps's directly fetchable session reports remain weeks behind, so the Arabic wire could not confirm this figure independently. The 52-week range on the same page is 523.61-678.45, so the new close sits near the top of that band but below its high. Covered as an economy story in both editions today (alquds-index-august-run-2026-08-24): a run of nearly five per cent on the month, on sessions worth under a million dollars.
